subject: The 3AM chart that saved 14%
preview_text: One screenshot, one AI verdict. How a retail trader stopped the bleed using a feature you already have.

Marco used the multi-source signal stack while the market slept, and it caught something his eyes missed: diverging on-chain volume that suggested accumulation.
